themes.name: Mist Gardens
themes.goal: Let the mist slow the arc

levels.name: First Spark
levels.review: 実操作前に指の押下→ゲージ→放す→着弾の無言プレビュー。敵は3発相当でも弱く撃ち、照準の修正に集中させる
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Tilt & Rise
levels.review: 坂を登る短い車体プレビューを先に見せ、塗装は自然な最初の弧へ置く。登った瞬間に砲口方向を短く発光
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Heavy Greeting
levels.review: この面の水は演出のみとし、水切り機能の正式導入をLv6へ移す。武器回収は初回プレビューと試用1発だけ
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Through the Capsule
levels.review: 壁の右上縁から敵まで爆風が届く配置へ。通常はかすめ0.5、BURSTなら直撃相当1を得やすい幅を設ける
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Open Horizon
levels.review: 射角変化の砲口表示を維持。回収位置は移動してもしなくても広い成功帯。敵3発は維持し、連続命中しやすくする
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Mirror Flats
levels.review: 水切りの透過プレビューを約1秒見せる。最初の安全射撃台では自然な浅角で成功。敵は初回水切り前後に動かさない
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Across the Shine
levels.review: 出口の直接射線は広いが回収物から外れる。水切りは回収＋敵命中を両立。通常移動の道は塞がない
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Needle Crossing
levels.review: 取得で自動装備しない。弾の飛び方の短いプレビュー後、任意の試用切替。基本砲はそのまま
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: The Second Angle
levels.review: 高台は敵本体へ安全に届くが、低い経路のほうが大きな判定へ通しやすい。水切り成功で見やすい命中演出
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Tideclaw
levels.review: 10発相当、広い背弱点は2発相当。足破壊のダメージも本体へ全量反映。初攻撃は予告が明瞭な低危険パターン
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: First Lock
levels.review: 初出プレビューで閉→開→二つの射線を見せる。初回2ラウンドは同状態、その後交互。状態変化は必ず操作前に完了
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Across the Lock
levels.review: 初出プレビューは無消費。到着車体と射線を見てから確定。ここでは高台転送で分かりやすく回収と命中がつながる
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Lifted Shield
levels.review: 転送先を万能高台でなく、開橋時に有利な低い側面へ変更。閉橋時は初期位置にも太い射線
levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Over the Gate

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Dune Run

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Canal Underpass

levels.name: Out of Cover

levels.name: First Hop

levels.name: Twin Hinges

levels.name: Cloudray

levels.name: Behind the Station

levels.name: Low Skips

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Long Rail

levels.name: Signal Green

levels.name: The Lower Window

levels.name: Wide Spread

levels.name: Prism Approach

levels.name: Prism Guardian

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Rising Sand

levels.name: Low Ceiling Lift

levels.name: At the Apex

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Fountain Arc

levels.designNote: 2026-10-27 user-approved 20 themes × 5 redesign; reflective solid ground replaces water.

levels.name: Golden Straight
